description: This file defines the AuthorizationException class in the OrangeHRM project, which extends the base Exception class and provides static methods to generate specific authorization-related exception messages.

classes.name: AuthorizationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for authorization errors in the OrangeHRM system with helper methods for specific error messages.

methods.name: entityNotSupported
methods.description: Returns an AuthorizationException indicating an unsupported entity type for a given method.

methods.name: entityNotImplemented
methods.description: Returns an AuthorizationException indicating an unimplemented entity type for a given method.

methods.name: methodNotImplemented
methods.description: Returns an AuthorizationException indicating a method is not implemented.
